wake.title: Wake-on-LAN
wake.cancelled: The request was canceled before any packets were sent.
wake.description: Choose the destination adapters while the host is online. Dashboard keeps their last confirmed MAC addresses for waking the host later.
wake.requirements: The NIC and firmware must support waking from the selected power state. This selection does not enable firmware or OS driver wake settings. A reachable Core sends the packets on its local IPv4 links; sending is not confirmation of startup.
wake.inventoryCache: Automatic observation reuses NIC inventory for up to 5 minutes; Refresh settings reads it again. Selection is read each time. Other ClientHosts learn changes while the PC is online, at most once per minute.
wake.sent: Magic Packets were sent. Startup is confirmed only when the PC is discovered again.
wake.partial: Some packets were sent, but some interfaces failed. Check whether the PC is discovered again.
wake.unconfirmed: The send result is unconfirmed. Packets are not resent automatically.
wake.noRoute: No IPv4 interface could send a Magic Packet.
wake.noRelay: No reachable Core is available to send Magic Packets.
wake.relayUnavailable: The selected Core did not send the request. Check its version and connection.
wake.notLearned: No saved NIC information is available. Let this ClientHost observe the PC online, or read Wake-on-LAN settings in HostManager before shutdown.
wake.noInterfaces: No usable adapters are selected. Check Wake-on-LAN settings in HostManager.
wake.alreadyOnline: The PC is online again. No Magic Packet was sent.
wake.unavailable: The saved NIC information or send route could not be confirmed. Nothing was sent.
Device.InvalidWakeSelection: The Wake-on-LAN adapter selection is invalid.
Device.WakeInterfaceChanged: A selected NIC is no longer in the retrieved inventory. Refresh its settings.
